title: Paintbrush with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Brush handle -->
  <rect x='40' y='62' width='18' height='34' rx='6' fill='#D2691E'/>
  <rect x='42' y='64' width='6' height='30' rx='3' fill='#E8A060'/>
  <!-- Ferrule (metal band) -->
  <rect x='37' y='54' width='24' height='12' rx='3' fill='#C0C0C0'/>
  <rect x='39' y='56' width='6' height='8' rx='2' fill='#E8E8E8'/>
  <!-- Bristles -->
  <path d='M38 54 L42 20 Q46 14 50 20 L54 20 Q58 14 62 20 L62 54 Z' fill='#F5C842'/>
  <!-- Bristle shading lines -->
  <line x1='44' y1='50' x2='43' y2='26' stroke='#D4A830' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='50' x2='50' y2='24' stroke='#D4A830' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='50' x2='57' y2='26' stroke='#D4A830' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Paint blob at tip -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='19' rx='13' ry='7' fill='#FF4D6D'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='17' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#FF8FA3'/>
  <!-- Smiling face on handle -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='72' r='3.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='72' r='3.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='72' r='1.8' fill='#2C2C54'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='72' r='1.8' fill='#2C2C54'/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx='47' cy='71' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='71' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Blush -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='78' rx='3' ry='1.8' fill='#FF8FA3' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='78' rx='3' ry='1.8' fill='#FF8FA3' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M43 79 Q49 86 55 79' fill='none' stroke='#2C2C54' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
